'''Sue Hays Whitesides''' is a Canadian mathematician and computer scientist, a professor emeritus of computer science and the chair of the computer science department at the [[University of Victoria]] in [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]].<ref>[http://www.csc.uvic.ca/Faculty_Staff/Profiles/profile_find.htm?name_of_profile=Sue_Whitesides Faculty profile] {{Webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20130101063039/http://www.csc.uvic.ca/Faculty_Staff/Profiles/profile_find.htm?name_of_profile=Sue_Whitesides |date=2013-01-01 }}, Univ. of Victoria, retrieved 2012-09-30.</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uvic.ca/engineering/computerscience/people/affiliated/index.php|title=Affiliated faculty - University of Victoria|website=www.uvic.ca|language=en-CA|access-date=2018-09-22}}</ref> Her research specializations include [[computational geometry]] and [[graph drawing]].

== Education and career ==
Whitesides received her Ph.D. in mathematics in 1975 from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]], under the supervision of [[Richard Bruck]].<ref name="mg">{{mathgenealogy|name=Sue Hays Whitesides|id=9574}}</ref> Before joining the University of Victoria faculty, she taught at [[Dartmouth College]] and [[McGill University]];<ref name="mg"/> at McGill, she was director of the School of Computer Science from 2005 to 2008.<ref>[https://www.mcgill.ca/reporter/38/02/computer/ Computer science summer camp: High school students spend week programming], McGill Reporter, September 8, 2005.</ref><ref>[http://www.canada.com/montrealgazette/news/business/story.html?id=b68d9aa5-a82b-4fc0-8801-095c2e6f61f9 Morgan Stanley boosts info-tech sector] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080503185208/http://www.canada.com/montrealgazette/news/business/story.html?id=b68d9aa5-a82b-4fc0-8801-095c2e6f61f9 |date=2008-05-03 }}, Montreal Gazette, May 2, 2008.</ref>

== Service ==
Whitesides was the program chair for the 1998 [[International Symposium on Graph Drawing]]<ref>[http://cgm.cs.mcgill.ca/~gd98/ Graph Drawing 1998 web site] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130429205301/http://cgm.cs.mcgill.ca/~gd98/ |date=2013-04-29 }}, retrieved 2012-09-30.</ref> and program co-chair for the 2012 [[Symposium on Computational Geometry]].<ref>[http://socg2012.web.unc.edu/ SoCG 2012 web site], retrieved 2012-09-30.</ref>
